name: Covenanters / Reformed Presbyterians

facts.value: covenants from 1557 and 1581. Cameronians stood apart from the religious settlement of 1689

citations.excerpt: The first “godly band” is dated December 1557; but more important is the covenant of 1581
They renounced their allegiance to King James and were greatly disappointed when their standards found no place in the religious settlement of 1689

facts.value_before_verify: covenants from 1557 and 1581. Cameronians separate after 1680 and the settlement of 1689

facts.value: Bound themselves by covenants to maintain Presbyterian doctrine and polity as the sole religion of their country.

citations.excerpt: The Covenanters were thus named because in a series of bands or covenants they bound themselves to maintain the Presbyterian doctrine and polity as the sole religion of their country.

facts.value_before_verify: Bound themselves by covenants to maintain Presbyterian doctrine and polity as the national religion.

facts.value: most Reformed Presbyterian ministers in Scotland joined the Free Church in 1876

citations.excerpt: a majority of the ministers of that church with their congregations were united with the Free Church in 1876.

research_notes: Reformed Presbyterian churches continue elsewhere; end applies to Scottish majority only.
